dct_creator_sm: Arthur Gandin (Université du Québec à Rimouski).
dct_description_sm:
This dataset originates from a controlled 6-month experiment conducted at the Institut des sciences de la mer de Rimouski (ISMER) and the Maurice-Lamontagne Institute (IML, Fisheries and Oceans Canada).
The study assessed the impact of five diet treatments (capelin, northern shrimp, mixed, and two switched diets) on redfish (Sebastes sp.):
   A. Feeding Behavior: Daily food consumption records.
   B. Growth Performance: Morphometric measurements and physiological indices.
   C. Otolith Chemistry: Trace element incorporation (Ba and Sr) analyzed via LA-ICP-MS transects.
dct_title_s: Supplementary data for: "Using otolith chemistry to characterize the diet of redfish (Sebastes sp.)"
